title: Drawings
description: The original drawings for Casa Meyer in Luis Barragán's hand.

blocks.html: Three sheets in Barragán's hand are held by the family: the south and west elevations, signed and dedicated on 31 October 1978, and a study for the pink lattice screen.

blocks.title: Fachada Sur

image.alt: Pencil elevation drawing titled Fachada Sur, dated 31 October 1978, dedicated to Baby Meyer de Garate
image.caption: Fachada Sur, 31 · X · 1978

blocks.html:
Pencil and ink on paper

The south elevation. Three volumes step up from left to right and close with a tall chimney wall. A low terrace wall runs across the front. Inscribed para Baby Meyer de Garate, con todo cariño, and signed.

blocks.title: Fachada Poniente

image.alt: Pencil elevation drawing titled Fachada Poniente at a scale of 1 to 50, dated 31 October 1978
image.caption: Fachada Poniente, 31 Oct 1978

blocks.html:
Pencil and ink on paper, scale 1:50

The west elevation. A tall shaded tower against a lower block, with steps descending along its base and a thin outline behind marking the wall beyond. Inscribed para Baby Meyer de Garate, con mi cariño, and signed.

blocks.title: Celosía

image.alt: Dimensioned drawing of the pink lattice screen with a single green square, on pink paper
image.caption: Study for the lattice

blocks.html:
Pencil and gouache on pink paper

Study for the pink lattice screen, 299 by 277 centimetres as drawn, with a door set into the right third and a single square of bright green beside it.
